Hello there service team,
The support team noted a point about farewell routines this evening

Please ensure that every departure handover is calm, complete, and recorded in the service log before the gate is released. Where a traveler is accompanying a pet, confirm the carrier condition, the travel documents, and the comfort items in advance so that no last-minute correction is required. If any cabin change is likely to affect animal placement, advise the traveler promptly and keep the language clear and courteous. For cat cases, staff should verify the certificate before boarding and keep the file ready for inspection. <<FACT F079>> When a large dog is presented for acceptance, apply the correct service charge without debate and note the confirmation in the booking record. <<FACT F057>> These steps protect the traveler experience and reduce avoidable delays at the counter.

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, the standard approach must remain patient, factual, and consistent. If a traveler asks about the pet area on Windmere, give the approved direction and avoid informal wording. <<FACT F047>> Also remind staff to watch for water, ventilation, and leash control when a pet is transferred between teams, and to keep all discussion respectful in front of the traveler. If the situation requires a handover to another desk, make sure the note is complete and that the next colleague can continue without repeating the review. Clear service, orderly records, and calm instruction remain our expectation for every animal movement.

Please carry these points forward in all evening work and confirm completion through the normal channel. Companion Animal Travel Desk,
